close_reason:
Already resolved by bd:JMAP-26di.55's commit 17033be. The build_chat_push_map helper extracted in .55 collapses the previous two-pass form (HashSet duplicate detection pass + serialize+insert pass) into a single-pass loop where the duplicate check is done via 'if chat_push_map.insert(key, value).is_some() { return Err(...) }'. Same semantics; the HashSet allocation is also eliminated.

Verified: misc.rs has zero remaining 'seen = HashSet::new()' patterns. The two former two-pass blocks (push_subscription_create and push_subscription_update Patch::Set arm) both now call build_chat_push_map.

No additional work needed for .56.
description: misc.rs:233-247 (and the duplicated 329-343) iterate the chat_push slice twice: once to detect duplicate account IDs via HashSet::insert, then again to build the chat_push_map. The two passes can be fused: 'for (account_id, config) in cp { if !seen.insert(account_id) { return Err(...); } chat_push_map.insert(account_id.as_ref().to_owned(), serde_json::to_value(config).map_err(...)?); }'. Same semantics, half the iteration cost, and lets the duplicate check short-circuit before serializing other entries. Engineering basis: minor perf (O(2N) → O(N)) and clearer intent — the duplicate check and the map insertion are part of the same per-entry work.
title: chat_push duplicate-check + map-build use two iterator passes where one suffices
